verdict.line: You lose if you let his Mist Walker ghoul count snowball into armor-shredded trades where Last Rites sustain outheals your damage; you win if you clear ghouls into Bladesurge resets and force an all-in by level 5 before his kit scales.

brief.thesis: Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) resets off Yorick's Mist Walker ghouls exactly like it does off minions, so killing his summons is simultaneously wave control, passive stacking, and a free gap-close — which is why OP.GG calls this an aggressive, Irelia-favoured lane at 51.4% over 1143 games despite Yorick's sustain. The lane swings on whether you clear ghouls before they swarm you or get boxed in by his W (Dark Procession) wall while his E (Mourning Mist) armor shred stacks.

theirWindow.when: Ghouls stacked up and his E ready
theirWindow.what: Back off the swarm and let him have the wave instead of trading into armor shred plus numbers — farm Q resets off casters from max range instead.

yourWindow.when: His E just went on cooldown, ghouls thin
yourWindow.what: Bladesurge onto him or a minion to close the gap, land E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then dump a charged W (Defiant Dance) before his Q sustain offsets the damage.

start.why: 52.1% win rate over 1208 games, 85.1% pick — the extra sustain and on-hit damage let you trade through his ghoul pokes instead of losing the lane HP war early.

boots.why: 50.5% win rate over 1026 games, 76.9% pick — Yorick's threat is steady physical autos plus ghoul swarm chip, and flat armor reduction blunts both.

core.why: Gives sustained damage and a slow to actually catch him before he walls off with Dark Procession.
Punishes his split-push plan by making you the stronger split-pusher once ghouls stop being a threat.

runes.keystoneWhy: Adaptive healing and ramping damage let you fight through his ghoul chip and Last Rites sustain in a drawn-out trade instead of losing the extended fight.

summoners.why: 88.4% pick rate at 51.7% win rate — Ignite cuts off Yorick's Last Rites self-heal mid-trade and converts your solo-kill advantage into an actual kill before he can reset.

playing.title: Clear ghouls with Q
playing.detail: Bladesurge onto Yorick's Mist Walkers to refresh the cooldown and stack Ionian Fervor attack speed, per OP.GG's own tip — don't let them pile up and swarm you in trades.

playing.title: Punish right after his E
playing.detail: Mourning Mist is on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown — if he just spent it on the wave, that's your window to Bladesurge in and land Flawless Duet's stun before he can reapply armor shred.

playing.title: Respect wall placement
playing.detail: Dark Procession drops a destructible wall at 600 range — don't dash in low on HP near terrain where he can box you in against it after a trade.

playing.title: Charge W only when safe
playing.detail: Defiant Dance hits harder the longer it charges and reduces physical damage taken while charging, but holding it exposes you to ghoul autos — only commit to a full charge once ghouls are dead or you're disengaging.

playing.title: All-in before ghoul count climbs
playing.detail: His passive Mist Walkers get worse the longer the wave goes uncontested — take your solo-kill shot in the level 3-5 window before his ghoul count and sustain scale past you.

playing.title: Ignite the Last Rites heal
playing.detail: Last Rites heals Yorick on his empowered attack — Ignite cuts that sustain mid-fight and turns a close trade into a kill.

playing.title: Save E for his split push
playing.detail: Once he starts split-pushing with ghouls and his wall mid-game, hold Flawless Duet's stun to punish an overextended push rather than spending it only on lane trades.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1 per OP.GG); the tactical reasoning — ghoul clear priority, E cooldown windows, wall positioning — is my own read of the kit.
